body: Ang pinaka-worth exploring dito baka hindi isang flashy instrument kundi interoperability. If LabDX is really entering implementation, magandang hanapin kung may workflow na kayang dumaan sa instruments from different vendors without custom glue code every step. Doon puwedeng maging multiplier ang automation: measurement data becomes reusable infrastructure, not isolated files. I’d ask vendors to demo the handoff itself—sample identity, metadata, recipe/context at API—not just the final AI screen.

claims.text: Cross-vendor interoperability may be a more consequential implementation signal than a standalone AI instrument demo.
claims.basis: Discover inference from the article's emphasis on connecting instruments, systems, data and automation
